title: mirql Job v1
description: Canonical queued job: a warrant-scoped unit of work with a role, a model tier, hard limits and a lease. Every number in the document must be a safe integer (Law 17); money is integer micro-USD.

role.description: Agent role that executes the job, e.g. `implementer`, `reviewer`, `architect`.

tier.description: Model tier budgeted for the attempt, e.g. `T1` (fast/cheap) .. `T3` (frontier).

base_sha.description: SHA-256 of the base commit the attempt must start from.

limits.description: Hard ceilings for the attempt (wall_ms, tool_calls, micro_usd, ...); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

lease.description: Single-writer lease granting exactly one supervisor the right to execute this job (owner, epoch, expires_at_ms, ...); integer-only numbers (Law 17).

idempotency_key.description: Key making enqueuer retries of the same job dedupable.
